title: Four stabbed in London's Covent Garden area; woman arrested
summary: A woman was arrested on suspicion of possession of an offensive weapon and assault after four men were stabbed in the Covent Garden area of central London. The incident occurred around lunchtime, with police believing it may have been a mental health-related incident. Four men were injured, but their conditions are not specified. The Metropolitan Police confirmed that the stabbings took place in Covent Garden, a popular tourist destination.

center: Associated Press reported the incident as a central London stabbing, without any framing or emphasis.
France 24 framed the incident as a tourist destination attack, highlighting the location of Covent Garden.
कोवेंट गार्डन में चार लोग घायल हुए: महिला संदेह में हथियार रखने की संभावना और हमले के आरोप में गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया।
असोसिएटेड प्रेस ने घटना को एक मध्य लंदन की घायल घटना के रूप में रिपोर्ट किया, बिना किसी फ्रेमिंग या जोर दें।
फ्रांस 24 ने घटना को एक पर्यटक स्थल हमले के रूप में प्रस्तुत किया, कोवेंट गार्डन की स्थिति को उजागर किया।
